evidence: What is done well: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:14 states 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails', and most refusal/suppression criteria in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml carry an in-criterion control with a fail clause: cw_format_error_keeps_draft (209), cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget (263), cw_time_limit_recovery (281), cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (290), cw_newer_run_supersedes (299), cw_dynamic_code_refused (317), cw_stale_save_refused (335), cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (344), cw_history_restore_retry (353), cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (371). Polish cw_undo_redo_availability and cw_unsaved_marker pair each absent state with the present state. Two negative legs have no matching control. (1) judge.toml:308 cw_preview_isolation: 'try to fetch the health address, and try to fetch a public https address ... None may obtain ... a network response.' The listed controls are the library entry, the health address in a normal tab, and own-preview DOM/console. Nothing shows the public https address is reachable from the judge browser or readable cross-origin, so that leg passes by absence when the judge picks an address without CORS headers (the golden test itself uses https://example.com, qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/runtime.cjs:162) or when the address is unreachable. The health control is a tab navigation, not the fetch transport: from an opaque-origin sandbox the health fetch fails on CORS alone. environment/instructions/security.md:3 requires that the preview cannot read anything over the network. (2) judge.toml:155 cw_replace_all_atomic: 'type one new character and then try Redo with the keyboard shortcut: the replacements must not come back.' Inside this criterion Redo is only shown working through the visible Redo control; the keyboard Redo shortcut is never shown to work here, and prompt.md:10 forbids carrying a verdict across criteria. Requirement: environment/instructions/ui.md:11 'a new edit after Undo clears Redo'. Lesser observations (Note level): gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 has no explicit fail when the typed word is not displayed at all (the render gate covers typing); polish/judge.toml:23 grades only controls 'the app offers', so missing Format/Find/Replace make that criterion easier. No configured judge run exists, so these are source findings, not measured misgrades.
counterexample: Broken app A: preview is an iframe with sandbox='allow-scripts' and no connect-src restriction. The judge's draft fetches https://example.com (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin) and the health address (server sends no CORS header); both reject with a CORS TypeError, the draft logs 'failed', and cw_preview_isolation is credited, although the same preview can read any CORS-enabled public endpoint, contrary to security.md:3. Broken app B: visible Undo/Redo buttons work, the keyboard Redo shortcut is unbound, and the redo stack is not cleared by a new edit. In cw_replace_all_atomic the final keyboard Redo does nothing, so 'the replacements must not come back' holds and the 1.5-weight criterion passes while a click on the Redo button would reapply the replacements. Conforming alternative: none found that this row would wrongly fail.
suggested_fix: cw_preview_isolation: add as a working control that the judge first opens the chosen public https address in a normal tab and sees it load, and require an address that allows cross-origin reads (a public CORS-enabled endpoint); fail the criterion if that control cannot be performed. cw_replace_all_atomic: make the final attempt with the visible Redo control already proven in this criterion (or with both the control and the shortcut), and fail if the replacements return by either.
